name: france1940

question.text: How would French combat-aircraft production from January 1937 through May 1940 have changed under British working hours and without the 1936 labour settlement? We want to disprove the conclusion of Nobody Decides to Decline (https://juliawillemyns.substack.com/p/nobody-decides-to-decline), by building and testing a richer Bayesian nonlinear dynamical causal model, rather than reproducing the article's specification. The question is whether its attribution to working-time restrictions survives more complicated arguments about latent industrial activity, uncertain actual aviation hours, delayed capacity and workforce adjustment, costs, reorganisation, mobilisation, fatigue, learning, and competing production-versus-delivery measurements. Distinguish removing the settlement from imposing longer hours, and allow their net effects to be harmful, negligible or beneficial. Propagate uncertainty and assess sensitivity to these mechanisms and identifying assumptions; the aim is to challenge the conclusion, not to encode its rejection in the priors. These are controlled counterfactuals beginning in January 1937, conditional on the recorded external paths, not estimates of military readiness or of an alternative June 1936 history.

indicator:aircraft_spot_rate_log.how_to_measure: Two specifically dated La Chambre production-rate reports, quoted through the appendix; broad fixed log-scale reading error reflects their period and source-definition uncertainty.

indicator:annual_aircraft_produced.how_to_measure: Original Frankenstein annual combat-aircraft production count over its UTC calendar year; no cumulative transformation or monthly allocation.

indicator:annual_armament_effort.how_to_measure: Published annual armament share of national income, percent. A conditional yearly effort index, not monthly orders or realised investment.

indicator:august_calendar.how_to_measure: August seasonal indicator; holiday months remain in the likelihood.

indicator:aviation_arbitration.how_to_measure: April 1938 aviation-hours arbitration regime; its realised hours effect is estimated.

indicator:aviation_employment_log.how_to_measure: Read log(aviation headcount/20000). Only two source-backed snapshots are present, at the declared year-end boundary and month-midpoint approximations; do not fill other dates.

indicator:aviation_reorganisation.how_to_measure: Approximate 1937-mid-1938 nationalisation/retooling episode; independent signed effect.

indicator:coal_log.how_to_measure: Distinct industrial-activity proxy, log native series relative to its documented scale; not independent duplicate source quotations.

indicator:employment_log.how_to_measure: Recorded SGF employment index, log / 80, exact at survey midpoint under the single-indicator convention.

indicator:engineering_output_log.how_to_measure: Original log mechanical-engineering output index / 100. This measures general engineering activity; it is not relabelled as installed aviation capital.

indicator:exchange_log.how_to_measure: Log of the published monthly franc-dollar index relative to 15.2. Conditional external path held fixed.

indicator:hours_index_reading.how_to_measure: Pre-November-1935 native hours index; distinct time support from the absolute series. Its scale conversion is estimated, not filled into the data.

indicator:hours_override.how_to_measure: Explicit controlled-hours experiment switch; 0 historical latent aviation hours, 1 prescribed weekly_hours. Sustained exogenous control avoids mistaking a one-time endogenous-state assignment for a permanent intervention.

indicator:industry_hours_reading.how_to_measure: SGF all-industry first-week survey in native weekly hours.

indicator:industry_index_log.how_to_measure: Log SGF industry index / 80; midpoint reading with explicit monthly-support approximation.

indicator:investment_origin.how_to_measure: Read the recorded numeric value in investment_origin; empty cells are unknown. The selected model owns the exact annual, biennial or point support.

indicator:june_occupations.how_to_measure: June 1936 industrial occupations; a transient shock distinct from continuing restrictions.

indicator:labour_settlement.how_to_measure: June 1936 workplace settlement in force. Policy effects are conditional on the external paths declared in this candidate.

indicator:light_alloy_log.how_to_measure: Original log light-alloy invoicing / 1200, a material-supply proxy on its recorded support.

indicator:materials_price_log.how_to_measure: Log raw-material wholesale index / 500, with its own offset and loading.

indicator:metal_hours_reading.how_to_measure: Metalworking hours proxy; noisy native survey with a sector offset, not an aviation-hours reading.

indicator:production_origin.how_to_measure: Definitional zero at the study origin.

indicator:public_aircraft_enterprises_pr.how_to_measure: Six national airframe companies were established during the source's 1936–1937 interval. The positive count establishes presence by the interval end. It does not identify the exact implementation date or turn the reported count into a monthly series. The conditional input's existing September 1936 transition remains an authored approximation.

indicator:public_aircraft_investment_ann.how_to_measure: Read the recorded numeric value in public_aircraft_investment_annual; empty cells are unknown. The selected model owns the exact annual, biennial or point support.

indicator:public_aircraft_investment_bie.how_to_measure: This column is deliberately empty because its report's realised-versus-planned scope is unresolved. Retain missingness; never substitute or infer a value.

indicator:steel_hours_reading.how_to_measure: Iron-and-steel hours proxy, with its own sector offset; conditional residual independence is a substantive approximation.

indicator:steel_log.how_to_measure: Distinct industrial-activity proxy, log native series relative to its documented scale; not independent duplicate source quotations.

indicator:war.how_to_measure: September 1939 mobilisation regime, held fixed in the policy contrasts.

indicator:weekly_hours.how_to_measure: Prescribed weekly hours when the controlled-hours experiment is enabled; otherwise dormant.

indicator:wholesale_log.how_to_measure: Log wholesale-price index / 500 at its recorded month-end point.

data.context: Native numeric readings with empty cells unknown. Keep all existing units, original annual production supports and point approximations. Of the previous 615 values, retain 614 unchanged and exclude only the ambiguous 1938–39 investment total; its source record remains archived. Add two aviation headcount snapshots from Frankenstein p.777, logged relative to 20000. Their source labels are Fin 1938 and Septembre 1939; the declared point approximations are 1939-01-01 and 1939-09-15. Never interpolate employment or turn annual totals into monthly readings. The 1934 headcount informs an initial prior only; other imprecisely dated workforce figures are not inserted. Origins are accounting definitions. Three new labour-pool proxies retain explicit source dates and transformations. Exact duplicate quotations collapsed, annual means excluded from the point channels, pre-1934 evidence retained as context only. Add ten nonoverlapping Paris ordinary-labourer wage means: annual 1934/1935 and quarterly 1936Q3–1938Q2. This branch does not impute strikes, union-density dates or post-1938 wages.
